supersedes: ../AUTHOR.json describes the pre-fix author scope. Its passing runs did not cover the independently discovered persistent Copy capture mutation bug, so they do not establish correctness of the repaired final candidate.

finding.observed: Types, Analyze, raw Verify and Wire Verify accepted; original LLVM API O0 executable returned 2 instead of 0 when the second call failed to observe count=2.
finding.preservation: Unchanged pre-fix source/typed/LLVM/executable/report/streams from two independent reviewer runs are archived; ORIGINAL-EXIT2-REPLAY.json records actual author replay of each unchanged executable returning 2. Imported reviewer artifacts and author replays are not counted as independent acceptance.
finding.original_log_availability: Reviewer confirmed dev01/dev02 cargo stderr existed only in tool replies and was not saved as a local log. No original cargo log is fabricated; unchanged executables are retained and their exit2 results are explicitly author replays.

root_cause: InferBuilder::block traversed Defer as an ordinary Block, so nested_depth was not increased. The outer move closure was correctly FnMut with written=true, but address_written remained false. Inner defer wrote the outer activation local through BorrowLocalMut; without Load/WriteCapture at exit, later callback invocations reloaded the old stored Copy capture.
fix: Give Defer its own capture-use traversal branch, temporarily increasing nested_depth exactly as for a non-move nested closure. Existing nested_writeback classification then emits final Copy capture writeback through the ordinary scope cleanup path. Nested move snapshot suppression and capture permissions are unchanged.
